rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for saying that something happened a stated amount of time ago.

example.english: I moved house three years ago.
example.jyutping: ngo5 saam1 nin4 cin4 bun1 zo2 uk1

rows.note: Use 之前 after a duration when you want the fuller form, as in 十年之前 for “ten years ago.”

example.english: I lived in this area ten years ago.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sap6 nin4 zi1 cin4 zyu6 gwo3 ni1 keoi1
